Assume \(D\) is even on \([-1,1]\) and strictly increasing on \([0,1]\), \(J\) is continuous on \([0,1]\),
\[
J(0)=\gamma_\lambda,
\]
and
\[
J'=j
\]
on \((0,1)\). Then
\[
H(u)\geq\gamma_\lambda
\]
for \(0\leq u\leq1/3\).
